pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-06.png with Read and it loaded and displayed correctly. It is a 1024x1536 page with two stacked panels and the page number 6 at the bottom. All text was legible. Natural reading order, left to right and top to bottom: Panel 1 (top, wide, no characters). First the teal heading label at top left, 'SPECIALITY-SPECIFIC TREATMENT PLANNER'. Then the large empty middle. Then the three teal labels along the bottom, left to right: 'Dentist: odontogram', 'Eye doctor: eye markers', 'Paediatrician: growth scales · vaccines'. Panel 2 (bottom, taller). The top-left area is empty, so my eye went first to the speech balloon at top right: 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' Its tail points down into the grey face box labelled ananya. Next to her, further right, is the silent grey face box labelled ravi. Only after that did I reach the teal label at lower left, 'PLAN OF CARE: intelligent prescribing · summary · drug interactions · labs · referrals'. The bottom third of panel 2 is empty.
pages.observation: 1) Panel 1 does not show where it is or who is looking. It contains only screen labels: no characters, no device frame, no place. On this page alone I cannot tell who is looking at the planner or whether it is the same room and moment as panel 2. If the art does not show a monitor or tablet held or viewed by Ananya or Ravi, it reads as a disconnected product insert. 2) The order of panel 2 is unclear. The balloon is high on the right and the PLAN OF CARE label is low on the left. So I read the dialogue first and the screen label afterwards, going backwards across the panel. A reader who scans the left edge first may read PLAN OF CARE before the line. Either way, the screen label and the spoken line do not clearly lead into each other, and nothing shows that the screen belongs to the conversation. 3) 'your concerns' and 'We'll' are unresolved references on this page. Nothing on page 06 shows what Ravi's concerns are. 'We' could mean Ananya and Ravi, or Ananya and the software. This depends on page 05, which I have not seen. 4) Relationship: Ananya speaks and Ravi is silent. There is no reaction from Ravi, so the panel's exit to the next page is only her statement. Their roles (doctor and patient?) can't be told from this page alone. 5) Panel 1 versus panel 2: panel 1 lists dentist, eye doctor and paediatrician tools. Panel 2 is a general consultation. It is unclear why specialty tools are shown right before a conversation that seems to involve none of those specialties. It reads like a feature list rather than a story beat. 6) Overlaps: the balloon sits above both face boxes, and its tail ends at the top edge of Ananya's box without crossing it. The tail passes close to her box, so check that it does not cut into her head once the art is drawn. Ravi's box is clear of the balloon. The PLAN OF CARE label is to the lower left of both faces and does not cover them. Nothing in panel 1 covers a face because there are no faces. 7) Space: the middle of panel 1 and the bottom third of panel 2 are large empty areas. The Paediatrician label is taller (three lines) than the other two, so the bottom row is uneven. Verdict from this image-only reading: changes are needed on the panel 1 screen context, the backwards reading in panel 2, and the unresolved 'your concerns'. The 'your concerns' point may be resolved by page 05, which this reading could not check.
